notes.title: April update
notes.content:
- Added a new quest which allows level 200 characters to restart the game to become stronger ('rebirths'). Reroll your unused level 200s for a new playthrough!
- Overhauled some of the 'remastered sprites'. These changes do not have an effect on OW graphics mode.
- Improved fonts and added other small improvements to the client. OW graphics mode fonts remain the same.
- Added a new end game area / boss fight.
- Added an NPC which allows you to re-roll end-game gear.

notes.title: Season 5
notes.content:
Season 5 is now live!

[u]season 5 mechanics[/u]

- Yendor mode characters can participate again in the level 1 - 200 race. Competition is separated by character class.
- Most time efficient level 1 - 200 runs win (its possible to do reruns to beat the level 200 efficiency records).
- Yendor mode characters can no longer benefit from clan bonuses and cannot participate in dailies.
- Yendor mode characters which activate the playerkiller flag can get an exp bonus.
- 'Souls-like' Invasion mechanics have now been introduced. You can /invade <target player>. Target needs to have PK flag on and you need to be within a certain level range. Anyone within level range can assist an invasion victim using the command /assist <victim name>.

[u]Patch notes[/u]

- Experience for certain quests has been capped for the appropriate level range.
- Added focus as a new resource to all classes ('rage' for warrior type characters).
- Certain special spells/skills consume focus. Certain spell/skill effects are based on focus.
- Regular damage (DPS) skills/spells do not require focus.
- Focus recovers over time. Idling or performing certain actions increases focus regen.
- The meditate skill improves focus.

notes.title: January patch
notes.content:
Updates:
- New parry animations/effects for melee.
- New item drop color indications (green = tier 1, blue = tier 2, orange = tier 3 and red = tier 4).
- Season 4 kicks off! Get to max level (level 200) on a 'Yendor mode' character as time-efficient as possible and win a 'wish'! Online time / experience efficiency is tracked per character (non-YM characters do not count!). Separate competitions per character class. Give it a try!

notes.title: Astonia Remastered launch
notes.content:
Astonia Remastered is now available. The Astonia TroY project shall live on as 'Astonia Remastered'. Trailer can be found here: https://www.astonia.eu/remastered_trailer.mp4

Astonia Remastered introduces a major graphics overhaul and lots more. Here's a list of new things:

- Graphics overhaul: All graphics have been redone in a much higher resolution (see the compare images in the store page). The same base 3d models were used to preserve the oldschool feel of the game.
- For those who want to keep using the original graphics, uncheck the 'remastered' checkbox in the launcher.
- You can now zoom in/out (check launcher options).
- New control scheme: Introducing 'combat mode' toggle. More intuitive controls for your character.
- New music in various areas (updated frequently).
- New quests/items (updated frequently).
- New class: Monk. A martial arts specialists.

Check out Astonia Remastered now! The game is absolutely free without any restrictions.

Coming soon: 
Season 4! Compete in the level 1 - 200 challange. Fastest level-up runs of each player class get a 'wish'.
